## Shared scenes

> During a game of dares at Diana's party, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attempts to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's roof and falls, breaking her ankle. Mr. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) carries her home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), making [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) realize how deeply she loves the girl. During her seven weeks of recovery, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives many visitors and eagerly anticipates returning to school under her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P15](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P23](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0023), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P24](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0024), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P30](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0030)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school in October and thrives under her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). She enthusiastically talks to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) about her schoolwork and field trips, though [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) remains critical. Later, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) proposes organizing a Christmas concert to raise money for a school flag, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) embraces wholeheartedly despite Marilla's skepticism and Matthew's encouraging support.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. > [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) secretly regrets her ongoing feud with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), though the two remain intense academic rivals. Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) confirms she will return to teach next year, relieved students pack away their studies, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) resolves to enjoy her summer before growing up. Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), expressing her relief over Matthew's health and admitting to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) how remarkably well [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has matured.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized

The Queen’s Class Is Organized P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends a restful summer outdoors before returning to her studies, discussing her growing maturity and moral thoughts with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). As the Queen's class prepares for the fateful [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations under Miss Stacy's guidance, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) notices Anne's rapid physical growth and quiet demeanor, sharing her fears of losing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) excitedly prepare [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and cook a feast to entertain Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md), but a series of mishaps occurs, including [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) ruining the lemon pies and accidentally knocking a heavy conch shell onto Miss Barry's borrowed platter. Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) fails to arrive, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) heartbroken until a letter reveals Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) sprained her ankle.
